name: The Emo Kid
source:
You just enrolled into a local community college. Thinking you'll get a good education, you thought nothing more of it all. That is...until you meet Ivan.

You have a week to get to know him, discover his secrets, and maybe even flirt with him a little. Who knows? Only one way to find out.

[From [url=https://dqrkskylight.itch.io/the-emo-kid]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚入读当地社区大学。你以为你会受到良好的教育，但你什么也没想到。那是……直到你遇到伊万。

你有一周的时间来了解他，发现他的秘密，甚至可能和他调情。谁知道？只有一种方法可以找出答案。

[来自[url=https://dqrkskylight.itch.io/the-emo-kid]Itch.io[/url]]
